title: Email preview from mime-tree cut by characters, not graphemes
description: draft-atwood-jmap-updates-00 §6.5: when a server shortens text such as the Email preview it SHOULD cut at an extended grapheme cluster boundary. mail-server parse.rs now does (JMAP-cayv.15), but jmap-mime copies MessagePreview from the external mime-tree crate (0.4, crates.io), which takes the first 256 decoded characters (mime-tree src/parse.rs:43) and can split a cluster; the cut cannot be repaired downstream because the text after it is gone. Options: ask mime-tree upstream for a grapheme-aware preview (or a longer raw preview that jmap-mime trims with jmap_types::text::truncate_graphemes_chars), or compute the preview in jmap-mime from the decoded text body. Audit: docs/design/updates.md §14.
